capabilities: Group notes into a project via a shared frontmatter property
Track combined word or character totals against a draft target
Compute daily session targets from a deadline and writing days
Show project and session progress in a sidebar view and status bar
Review per-project history with a calendar heatmap and daily deltas
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. A BRAT beta install channel is offered. Documentation is duplicated in Korean; the developer links a YouTube channel, blog, and Buy Me a Coffee donations. MIT licensed.
motivation: The author wanted Scrivener's Project Targets adapted for vaults where one manuscript lives in many separate notes.
problem: Obsidian has no Scrivener-style project targets for manuscripts split across many notes, so writers cannot see combined progress toward a draft goal.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Scrivener’s Project Targets — but built for vaults

summary: Writing goal tracker that groups notes into projects via frontmatter and tracks draft totals plus deadline-aware daily session targets.
